Name: Jeelh's Greenhouse
Author: Jeelh
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/FGalk28.png[/img]

This is a greenhouse expansion mod, there are 2 sizes to choose from and both can be decorated or clean.

-[b] The big map has a 15x20 crop area.
[b]Decorated fits 16 fruit trees, and clean fits 20.[/b]
[/b]
[b]- The small map has a 15x10 crop area.
Decorated fits 8 fruit trees, and clean fits 20.[/b]


The area you can plant the trees can be seen in the image gallery,
the tiles you can plant them on are slightly darker than the rest.

Currently working on a more natural version with grass floors.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KCilBwk.png[/img]

﻿[b]1[/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[b]2[/b]. Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[b]3[/b]. Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]
[b]4[/b]. Download Jeelh's Greenhouse
[b]5[/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder
[b]6[/b]. Launch the game and use GMCM to select which Greenhouse you would like
[i]
Make sure your greenhouse is completely empty before installing this mod or changing greenhouse sizes or you could face some issues.
Completely safe to change between decorated and clean for the same size, as long as items aren't where decorations go.[/i]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/jtASrD2.png[/img]
